quotes.title: K2-21
quotes.card: K2-21, also known as EPIC 206011691, is a red dwarf star located 273 light-years away in the constellation Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It hosts two known exoplanets, discovered in 2015 by the transit method as part of Kepler's K2 mission.
